# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Page navigation, styled after shadcn's Pagination (Base UI + vega).
  class Pagination < Base
    def view_template(&)
      nav(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "navigation",
        aria: {label: "pagination"},
        data: {slot: "pagination"},
        class: "mx-auto flex w-full justify-center"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class PaginationContent < Base
    def view_template(&)
      ul(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "pagination-content"},
        class: "flex items-center gap-1"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # "More pages" marker. Renders its own <li> (shadcn wraps it in
  # PaginationItem) and is hidden from assistive tech, as in shadcn.
  class PaginationEllipsis < Base
    def view_template
      li(data: {slot: "pagination-item"}) do
        span(**attrs) do
          icon
          span(class: "sr-only") { "More pages" }
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true"
      ) do |s|
        s.circle(cx: "12", cy: "12", r: "1")
        s.circle(cx: "19", cy: "12", r: "1")
        s.circle(cx: "5", cy: "12", r: "1")
      end
    end

    # aria-hidden needs the string: Phlex renders true as an empty value,
    # which doesn't hide the element.
    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "pagination-ellipsis"},
        class: "flex size-9 items-center justify-center [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One page link: shadcn's PaginationItem (<li>) and PaginationLink (<a>) in
  # one part. Attributes go to the <a>. It stays a plain link (no
  # role="button"): it navigates.
  #
  # size: takes Button sizes. The default, :icon, makes a 36px square for a
  # page number, as in shadcn; pass size: :default for a link with text.
  class PaginationItem < Base
    def initialize(href: "#", active: false, size: :icon, **attrs)
      @href = href
      @active = active
      @size = size
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      li(data: {slot: "pagination-item"}) do
        a(href: @href, **attrs, &)
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {current: @active ? "page" : nil},
        data: {slot: "pagination-link", active: @active ? "true" : nil},
        class: [
          RubyUI::Button.new(variant: @active ? :outline : :ghost, size: @size).attrs[:class]
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Link to the next page: text plus chevron, which collapses to the icon
  # below the sm breakpoint. text: changes the label.
  class PaginationNext < PaginationItem
    def initialize(href: "#", text: "Next", **attrs)
      @text = text
      super(href: href, size: :default, **attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      li(data: {slot: "pagination-item"}) do
        a(href: @href, **attrs) do
          span(class: "hidden sm:block") { @text }
          svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width: "24", height: "24", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none",
            stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round",
            aria_hidden: "true", data: {icon: "inline-end"}) do |s|
            s.path(d: "m9 18 6-6-6-6")
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      mix(super, {aria: {label: "Go to next page"}, class: "pr-2!"})
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Link to the previous page: chevron plus text, which collapses to the icon
  # below the sm breakpoint. text: changes the label.
  class PaginationPrevious < PaginationItem
    def initialize(href: "#", text: "Previous", **attrs)
      @text = text
      super(href: href, size: :default, **attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      li(data: {slot: "pagination-item"}) do
        a(href: @href, **attrs) do
          svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", width: "24", height: "24", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none",
            stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round",
            aria_hidden: "true", data: {icon: "inline-start"}) do |s|
            s.path(d: "m15 18-6-6 6-6")
          end
          span(class: "hidden sm:block") { @text }
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      mix(super, {aria: {label: "Go to previous page"}, class: "pl-2!"})
    end
  end
end

# Pagination

Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Pagination do
  PaginationContent do
    PaginationPrevious(href: "#")
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "1" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#", active: true) { "2" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "3" }
    PaginationEllipsis()
    PaginationNext(href: "#")
  end
end
```

### Simple

```ruby
Pagination do
  PaginationContent do
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "1" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#", active: true) { "2" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "3" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "4" }
    PaginationItem(href: "#") { "5" }
  end
end
```

### Custom labels

```ruby
Pagination do
  PaginationContent do
    PaginationPrevious(href: "#", text: "Anterior", aria: {label!: "Página anterior"})
    PaginationItem(href: "#", size: :default) { "Página 2 de 10" }
    PaginationNext(href: "#", text: "Próxima", aria: {label!: "Próxima página"})
  end
end
```
